The text below is the document as UK Intellectual Property Office (Lambert Toolkit) published it, under OGL-UK-3.0; Converted to Markdown from the legacy Word (.doc) file published by the UK Intellectual Property Office at gov.uk/guidance/university-and-business-collaboration-agreements-lambert-toolkit, kept beside this file as the download after being saved as .docx with Microsoft Word without changes. The Lambert Toolkit page states that the Lambert agreements and supporting materials are to be treated as Crown copyright, are free for universities, institutions and companies to use, adapt and re-use, and asks that their source be cited where practicable. The page footer states "All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated" (Crown copyright). NOTE: This is a sample of the kind of notification you would include on the front page of the document to indicate that it and the information provided are confidential

THIS DOCUMENT AND THE INFORMATION IN IT ARE PROVIDED IN CONFIDENCE, FOR THE SOLE PURPOSE OF [INSERT DETAILS], AND MAY NOT BE DISCLOSED TO ANY THIRD PARTY OR USED FOR ANY OTHER PURPOSE WITHOUT THE EXPRESS WRITTEN PERMISSION OF [INSERT DETAILS].
